name: Vertical farm
summary: Indoor controlled-environment farm (leafy greens/herbs/berries) with multi-tier hydroponic racks under LED lighting, priced per SF of gross building area. Cost is driven by the number of grow tiers (lighting and racking scale with tiers), HVAC/dehumidification sized to remove the lighting heat load, and the level of automation. No direct public per-SF benchmark could be retrieved this session (web search budget exhausted); the default is DERIVED from indoor cannabis cultivation component costs and a trade-press quote for multi-level indoor grows — verify.

typicalSize.method: Low ≈ small urban/container-cluster or retrofit farm; mid ≈ regional commercial farm (~1.4 acres under roof); high ≈ largest US flagship farms. Judgment — verify against operator disclosures.

primaryUnitsPerAcre.method: Single-story industrial building at 0.28–0.50 FAR (truck court, parking, stormwater), same as cannabis-cultivation.

perPrimaryUnit.method: Proxy build-up from indoor cannabis cultivation (mid $350/SF hard, 2026; Terrapin component costs in cannabis-cultivation e1): remove cannabis-specific security (−$10) and odor control (−$5.5) and part of insulated-panel room partitioning (−$10); add multi-tier grow-system premium: racking/automation from $16.5 to ≈ $45/GBA SF (+$28) and lighting raised for 3–6 tiers but at lower PPFD than flowering cannabis (≈ net −$27 vs cannabis lighting+HVAC, as leafy-greens light/heat loads per tier are lower). Net ≈ $325/SF. Cross-check e1: multi-level indoor cannabis canopies quoted at $300–320/SF (2019 $). Low $200 = warehouse retrofit with 2–3 tiers and manual handling; high $550 = highly automated, food-safety (cleanroom-style) facility with 8+ tiers. Verify with operator data.

scope.notes: Shell (or full-gut retrofit), insulated grow rooms, multi-tier hydroponic racking and LEDs, HVAC/dehumidification, water treatment/fertigation, electrical service, controls, food-safe finishes, packing/cold room, sitework, GC/OH&P. Excludes land, off-site utility upgrades, packaging line FF&E, soft costs.

qualityTiers.method: Economy = low/mid ($200/$325) retrofit with manual systems; premium ≈ automated conveyor/robotic systems; luxury = high/mid ($550/$325).

systemSplit.method: Adapted from the cannabis-cultivation split (itself built from Terrapin component costs): grow racks/automation (11) raised to 0.14; HVAC (23) 0.20→0.18 and electrical+lighting (26) ~0.21→0.20 for lower light intensity; security (28) cut to 0.01; controls (25) 0.04; shell/site/GC shares similar. Judgment — verify. Shell shares (03 0.05, 05 0.06, 09 0.03) trimmed slightly vs cannabis to close the sum.

lineItems.name: Multi-tier hydroponic grow racks, irrigation trays and handling automation

cost.method: Cannabis racking/benching $10–45 per canopy SF (Terrapin) scaled for 3–6 tiers over ~60% of floor area; automation (conveyors, robotic transplant/harvest) drives the high end. Verify.

lineItems.name: LED grow lighting for all tiers

cost.method: Cannabis lighting $25–60 per canopy SF at flowering intensity; leafy greens use roughly 1/3–1/2 the PPFD per tier but 3–6 tiers → ≈ $20–75 per floor SF. Verify.

lineItems.name: HVAC / dehumidification sized for lighting heat load

cost.method: Cannabis HVACD $30–100/SF GBA (Terrapin); mid placed slightly below the cannabis mid ($65). Verify.

lineItems.name: Water treatment (RO/UV), nutrient dosing and recirculation

cost.method: Assumption scaled to a 60,000 SF farm. Verify with vendor.
Placeholder: multi-tier lighting loads ≈ 40–100 W per floor SF → several MW for a mid-size farm. Verify with utility.

lineItems.name: Rooftop solar PV (offsets part of lighting load)

cost.method: Shared rooftop-solar-commercial block ($/kW). Qty ≈ 8 W per SF of roof (≈ 60% roof coverage).

perPrimaryUnit.method: Seeding, harvest and packaging lines, food-safety lab, office/break FF&E. Assumption — verify.

pctOfHard.method: Same basis as cannabis cultivation (Terrapin: soft 8–12% of hard) without cannabis licensing/consultant premium; high for first-of-kind custom systems engineering.

softCosts.notes: Excludes pre-opening operating losses and crop ramp-up.

design.method: Process-driven design with proprietary grow systems; integration risk.

perPrimaryUnit.method: All-in hard + soft (excl. land): retrofit low ≈ $200 × 1.08 → ~$175–220; automated high ≈ $550 × 1.18 + contingency ≈ $700.
